audit.scope: effect count bounded by distinct intents; UNKNOWN/unresolved may have effects; no nonexecution inferred

progress.scope: all attempts, skipped slots and matching closed journal proof; UNKNOWN/unresolved retained; no latency bound, full N5 or transport superiority claim

durable_outcomes.scope: success or qualified durable expiry only; not all-success deadline qualification

analysis.scope: local observed admission/error correlations, not durable absence, root-cause uniqueness, execution or replay authority
